# Barakat Qurtas

Independent Kurdish graphic designer in Hewler, Kurdistan Region of Iraq.

Primary pages:
- [Design portfolio](https://bqurtas.com/design) — portfolio by discipline.
- [Panjamor Office Studio](https://bqurtas.com/panjamor) — brand, print and launch systems for business owners.
- [Selected work](https://bqurtas.com/work) — brand identity case studies.
- [Brand Board](https://bqurtas.com/brandboard) — bilingual identity starter.
- [The Journal](https://bqurtas.com/blog) — notes on typography, place and design practice.
- [Biography](https://bqurtas.com/bio) — biography, experience and skills.
- [Contact](https://bqurtas.com/contact) — project enquiries.

Panjamor Office Studio:
Panjamor is a focused studio room for name checks, logo direction, Kurdish and Latin lockups, colour palettes, type pairing, printed matter, social launch kits, production-ready exports and owner handover.

Languages:
The site is available in English, Sorani Kurdish, Kurmanci Kurdish, Arabic, French, Turkish and Swedish.
